name: A second chance
source:
Kentaro was a normal college student raising his step sister..

that's until Kentaro found her in a fight.  Kentaro ran in the way and got struck leading to him dyeing,

Kentaro gets a second chance. he will rewrite his story in a new fantasy world.
translation:
健太郎是一名普通大学生，抚养着继妹。

直到健太郎在一场战斗中发现了她。健太郎跑到路上被击中，导致他染色，

健太郎获得了第二次机会。他将在一个新的奇幻世界中重写他的故事。
